about: checkpoint 2 lethal audit (results/lethal/checkpoint2-f{a,b}.json; h0 on 8e66bcf, v2 default leaf, solver budget 50000): the games that contain a chance-dependent-only kill turn, with full action logs replayed on the build of d5f4310 using the audit's play_one and policy h0:net=engine/models/h0-linear-v2.json for both seats (bot_action(spec, seed + n) for the n-th action; actions[0..1] are the mulligans). A decision record's ply = the number of actions applied before it. replay_verified: the winner matches the audit record and the solver re-finds a dice-dependent kill (verdict lethal, rng_dependent true) at every decision of those turns.

definitions.chance_kill_turn: an (auditee, turn) whose missed_lethal decisions with verdict 'lethal' all have rng_dependent true (no luck-free kill at any point of the turn)
definitions.converted: the auditee won during that turn (as recorded by the audit)
